learning: AI-model comparison is a decision capability, not a static article. The canonical unit is user goal + hard governance constraints + cost-per-task + explainable alternatives.
prevention: Do not collapse EU storage into EU inference or sovereignty.
Do not optimize for benchmark ranking alone.
Do not use stale model names or prices without official-source freshness.
Do not gate the first useful recommendation behind lead capture.
next_decision: Route model/provider questions through the canonical AI Model Intelligence catalog and advisor surface.
problem: AI model recommendations can become wrong when pricing/lifecycle data is stale or when residency is incorrectly treated as sovereignty.
